verdict.rationale: CodeRabbit's own documented behaviors run in the background without a prompt. Configurable auto-review fires within moments of a PR opening and can be scoped by branch, label, keyword or draft status. It also analyzes CI/CD failures and posts fixes automatically, keeps a self-updating Triage queue with scheduled Slack digests, and runs an automated request-changes/approve workflow. These are fixed, review-centric automations you tune rather than general automations you define: finishing-touch recipes are one-click, manually triggered actions, not autonomous jobs. Missing for 10: user-defined triggers or scheduled autonomous agent tasks beyond review, autonomous execution of custom recipes, independent hands-on corroboration of background automation.
